_meta.purpose: Consolidated machine-readable source for the oyatie target platform architecture, derived from the 14 foundational keystone ADRs (ADR-0242 through ADR-0255). Current substrate topology resolves to /specs/substrate-dependency-dag.json; this document's substrate_dag_canonical_ordering block is stale v1 compatibility data with current_parity_claim=false until W0-C-TOPOLOGY-COVERAGE replaces it. Other domains cover tenancy doctrine, policy gates, substrate-vs-product layering, compliance packs, deployment models, intelligence, time and consistency, network topology, marketplace, self-modification, and certification gates.

tenancy.doctrine_summary: oyatie operates its own platform as a first-class tenant of the platform. No internal carve-outs. Every workload is a principal under a tenant; oyatie is one tenant among many.
tenancy.reserved_namespace_normalisation: NFKC + lowercase + diacritic-strip + UTS#39 confusable removal

ephemeral_tenant_classes.purpose: per-engineer local development against the real platform with isolated data
per-PR ephemeral preview tenant for reviewer evaluation
long-running CI jobs (e.g., multispectrum review) get an ephemeral tenant

policy.doctrine_summary: Cedar is the universal policy engine. Every routing, authorization, activation, attribution, retention, eligibility, gate, and decision-with-policy-implication is evaluated by Cedar. Code never decides policy; code asks the policy engine and acts on the answer.
policy.engine_provider: AWS-backed (cedarpolicy.com); reference impl AWS Verified Permissions
policy.brown_out_signal_emission: degraded on cache fallback; outage on >1% default-deny over 30s
policy.fragment_lifecycle_transition_required_r: multispectrum-review v2.4.0 facets F1, F2, F5, F6, F7, A1, A4, A6

signing.root_key_storage: tier-0 HSM (Shamir-shared M-of-N among founding team)

intermediate_keys_per_scope.tenant: tenant-admin-key (per tenant; via tenant admin console)

policy.per_tenant_overlay_composition_formula: effective_policy(T) = baseline ∪ overlay[jurisdiction(T)] ∪ overlay[secondary_jurisdictions(T)] ∪ ⋃ pack_fragments[pack ∈ active_packs(T)] ∪ tenant_fragments[T]
tenant_fragment_restrictions: tenant may forbid actions baseline permits (more restrictive)
tenant may permit baseline-permits conditional on attributes
tenant CANNOT permit actions baseline forbids

minimum_gates_per_microservice.minimum_fragments: one permit + one default-deny per action type
pack overlay fragment per applicable pack
pack fragment installed at pack adoption
per event class -> audit stream selection fragment

policy_class_decisions_migrated_from_cod: provider routing in Intelligence (data-class -> LLM provider)

kubernetes_admission_policy.non_claim: This records launch substrate direction; concrete policies, controllers, and gates require future ChangeSets.

policy.kyverno_status_after_2026_05_25_directiv: first-class adapter; not the default admission substrate

microservice_taxonomy.doctrine_summary: Every microservice declares a tier. Substrates are audience-neutral and capability-focused; products are tenant-scoped and surface-focused; service-cells are dedicated-function peer cells; reserved are non-deployed certification-gated placeholders.
cross_tier_dependency_rules: substrates MAY depend on lower-tier substrates per the DAG
substrates MUST NOT depend on products
substrates MUST NOT depend on service-cells
service-cells MAY depend on substrates and other service-cells
service-cells MUST NOT depend on products
products MAY depend on other products (per ADR-0145 invariants)
reserved MAY declare planned_dependencies only; no live deps until promotion

substrate_dag_canonical_ordering._comment: STALE HISTORICAL V1 PROJECTION — NOT CURRENT PARITY AND NOT AN INDEPENDENT SSOT. ADR-0635 replaced the flat v1 source shape with a bounded graph-v2 slice of 19 face-qualified units spanning 11 of 24 capabilities. The legacy tier1_bootstrap_order, tier1_dependency_strata, and tier2_and_meta_forward_declared values below are retained only for compatibility/provenance; they are not derived from graph v2 and must not drive bootstrap, coverage, or completion claims. The sole current machine authority is specs/substrate-dependency-dag.json. W0-C-TOPOLOGY-COVERAGE must ratify the 13 omitted capabilities and missing compute/storage/k8s B0 hosting faces, update typed edges and derived failure closure, then replace this projection atomically without minting a new baseline.

tier2_and_meta_forward_declared._comment: Historical v1 forward declarations retained for compatibility only. Names and placements here are not current graph-v2 coverage, current capability-registry parity, or a completion claim. W0-C-TOPOLOGY-COVERAGE must ratify exact face tuples and typed edges before a replacement projection is generated; governance remains cross-cutting rather than a 25th capability.

cellular_topology.doctrine_summary: Amazon-shape cellular architecture. Workloads run in isolated cells with bounded blast radius. Cross-cell traffic governed by Cedar permits. Shuffle sharding minimises correlated impact.

tier_0_external.description: External substrate not under oyatie operational control

tier_1_bootstrap_cell.description: Minimal K8s cluster used only to bring up tier-2; self-retires after handoff
components: identity (Zitadel) initial admin + OIDC for oyatie org
tier_1_bootstrap_cell.lifetime: until tier-2 handoff complete; then self-retires

tier_2_control_plane_cells.description: Control-plane cells host substrate µservices and orchestrate data-plane cells
tier_2_control_plane_cells.deployment: per-region; minimum 3 per regional pack for HA

tier_3_data_plane_cells.description: Data-plane cells host product workloads and tenant data
tier_3_data_plane_cells.tenant_to_cell_binding: deterministic via tenant.home_cell + Cedar routing fragment

tier_4_reserved_financial_grade.description: Certification-gated isolated cells for financial-grade workloads

shuffle_sharding.isolation_property: two tenants share at most 1/8 of cells in expectation
shuffle_sharding.purpose: minimise correlated blast radius when a cell fails

cellular_topology.isolation_property: any single cell loss tolerable for 24 hours before regional DR escalation; per-tenant home_cell pair (home + dr) survives a 24h window without escalation

blast_radius_bounding.single_az_failure_handled_by: active-active multi-AZ within region (T1) or active-passive within region (T2)
blast_radius_bounding.provider_failure_handled_by: sovereign cloud overlay secondary provider per ADR-0240

compliance_packs.doctrine_summary: Compliance packs are first-class versioned signed bundles. A pack bundles Cedar fragments, IaC overlays, audit-schema additions, data-class registrations, retention policies, and regulator evidence emitters required to operate under a specific regulatory framework.

pack_signing.signing_authority: per-pack-owner-key held by pack regulator team

supported_packs.scope: Personal data processing in EU + EEA

supported_packs.framework: KR PIPA + Personal Information Protection Act

supported_packs.scope: Electronic payment service providers in KR
Protected Health Information in the US

supported_packs.source_revision_status: source-version planning only; exact control text waits on permitted PCI SSC v4.0.1 PDF acquisition

supported_packs.scope: US Federal cloud workloads with high impact
European payment services + strong customer auth
AI systems with EU users; tier-based risk classification

supported_packs.framework: JP APPI (Act on the Protection of Personal Information)

compliance_packs.pack_activation_per_tenant_gate: Cedar fragment evaluating KYB-verified + jurisdiction-match + DPIA-signed

deployment_models.description: oyatie-operated cells on oyatie-controlled regional packs; multi-tenant
deployment_models.compliance_packs_supported: all packs whose cell certification level matches
deployment_models.deployment_substrate: oyatie cells across regional packs per ADR-0240

deployment_models.description: oyatie-operated cells dedicated to a single tenant; multi-cell capable
deployment_models.compliance_packs_supported: all packs whose cell certification level matches; tenant may extend
deployment_models.deployment_substrate: oyatie cells with tenant-pinned shuffle shard

deployment_models.description: Tenant brings their own cloud account/subscription; oyatie deploys control plane into it
deployment_models.compliance_packs_supported: tenant choice; oyatie validates pack-cell compatibility

deployment_models.description: Tenant-operated on-prem cells with control-plane connectivity to oyatie
Tenant-operated on-prem cells with no oyatie connectivity
deployment_models.compliance_packs_supported: tenant-required packs; oyatie-provided pack bundles delivered out-of-band
deployment_models.deployment_substrate: tenant on-prem K8s + full substrate stack
deployment_models.update_mechanism: signed offline bundle delivery (cosign-attested USB / encrypted transfer)

intelligence_substrate.doctrine_summary: Intelligence is a two-layer substrate. The AI Substrate is audience-neutral and serves all tenants; the Consumer Brand Surface layer is a product that wraps the substrate with consumer UX. BYOK everywhere.
intelligence_substrate.provider_routing_decision: Cedar fragment based on data_class + tenant.jurisdiction + tenant.compliance_packs + cost-budget

time_coordination.doctrine_summary: Hybrid Logical Clock as default; TrueTime-class for high-precision-critical workloads; smear for leap seconds; causal consistency by default with stronger guarantees for substrates.
time_coordination.default_clock_implementation: Hybrid Logical Clock per Kulkarni et al. 2014; tolerance ±2s vs NTP-synced wall clock
time_coordination.high_precision_clock_implementation: GPS+atomic-disciplined NTP fleet; per-region TrueTime API; tolerance ±10ms with explicit interval
time_coordination.idempotency_key_storage: Valkey per-cell + Postgres write-through for durable mutations
time_coordination.exactly_once_semantics_via: idempotency_key + outbox + at-least-once delivery + consumer dedup

network_topology.doctrine_summary: Anycast GeoDNS at the apex; Cloudflare Workers (managed cells) then Pingora-class edge (oyatie-operated cells); Cilium ambient mesh for east-west; SPIFFE/SPIRE for workload identity; TLS 1.3 minimum; post-quantum hybrid by Year 2.
network_topology.apex_dns_substrate: multi-provider (Cloudflare DNS + NS1 / managed) with health-checked failover
network_topology.edge_layer_managed_cells: Cloudflare Workers + R2 + KV (for shared-cloud deployment model)
network_topology.edge_layer_self_operated_cells: Pingora-class Rust proxy (per ADR-0211 in-house preference)
network_topology.tls_certificate_authority: internal CA via OpenBao PKI for east-west; public CA (Let's Encrypt + ACME) for north-south
network_topology.http3_substrate: Cloudflare Workers (north-south) + quiche/quinn (Rust QUIC) for self-operated cells
network_topology.egress_default: denied; permitted via Cedar fragment + NetworkPolicy
network_topology.ddos_protection: Cloudflare + per-cell rate limiting via api-gateway
network_topology.inter_provider_tunnel: WireGuard mesh between sovereign-pack secondary providers; only for non-prohibited data classes
network_topology.container_sandboxing_runtime_rejection_e: gVisor explicitly rejected per portfolio doctrine; Cloud Hypervisor provides VM-grade isolation with lower overhead
network_topology.wasm_runtime_capability_model: WASI Preview 2 with Cedar-gated capability allowlist per plugin

marketplace.doctrine_summary: Multi-category marketplace built on shared substrates. Plugins/apps/connectors are first-class products. Marketplace is a service-cell, not a substrate. Surfaces include physical goods, C2C, services, subscriptions, plugins.

surface_to_product_mapping.subscriptions: future product (folds into existing tenancy billing)

deliverables: regulatory broadening (financial marketplace, healthcare marketplace post-HIPAA, etc.)

self_modification.doctrine_summary: oyatie operates and modifies itself. The autonomous masterplan executes via oyatie.foundry.* principals under Cedar gates. The platform builds, evaluates, and ships its own changes.

bootstrap_stages.component: Tier 0: hardware + DNS apex + git host + container registry
bootstrap_stages.action: External setup (cloud provider account, GitHub Enterprise org, registry)
kubeadm init + Cilium CNI + minimal etcd
Shamir-shared root unseal + service-account credentials seeded
Initial admin + OIDC client for oyatie org
Migration 0001_create_self_tenant.sql creates oyatie tenant row (hard-coded ID, reserved namespace)
Bootstrap Cedar fragment set signed by org root key per ADR-0246 bootstrap
Provisions oyatie tenant audit stream + Ed25519 signing key in OpenBao; replays bootstrap log retroactively
Registers Tier 1 cell, marks it as bootstrap-class
Deploys minimal Workflow Engine; loads bootstrap workflows
oyatie.foundry.ci-agent principal performs first build of next-stage components
Bootstrap cell self-retires per ADR-0247; Tier 2 control plane cell takes over

self_modification_blast_radius_bounds.may_modify_org_root_key: no; requires annual ceremony with founding team Shamir quorum
self_modification_blast_radius_bounds.may_modify_compliance_pack_signing_keys: no; requires per-pack regulator team quorum

self_modification.evidence_retention_for_self_modification: audit-chain retention per jurisdiction; minimum 7y for substrate modifications

certification_gates.doctrine_summary: Build ahead of certification. Reserved microservices ship their full artifact set (PRD, threat-model, contracts, IaC) but cannot deploy until certification is obtained. Each reserved service declares its certification gate explicitly.

certifications_required.source_revision_status: source-version planning only; exact control text waits on permitted PCI SSC v4.0.1 PDF acquisition

certifications_required.scope: Money transmitter licensing per US state

certifications_required.authority: US SST (Streamlined Sales Tax Governing Board)
certifications_required.scope: US sales tax certified service provider

build_ahead_of_certification_artifacts_r: manifest.json with tier: reserved + planned-launch-date + certification-gate
build_ahead_of_certification_artifacts_p: NetworkPolicy egress permits to reserved namespace
certification_gates.promotion_via: multispectrum-reviewed promotion ADR (one per reserved microservice)

dr_business_continuity.doctrine_summary: Four DR tiers per microservice with declared RTO/RPO, replication shape, drill cadence, and last-drill-evidence-id. Cross-tier coordination via brown-out signal.

cross_tier_coordination.rule: A higher-tier microservice depending on a lower-tier microservice MUST tolerate the lower tier's RTO via brown-out signal

sovereign_cloud_overlays.doctrine_summary: Each regional pack declares a sovereign-cloud overlay enumerating primary + secondary providers and data classes that must remain on those providers. Cross-provider sovereign-data traffic denied at Cedar policy time.

observability.doctrine_summary: Per-tenant + per-sub-scope rollup. OpenTelemetry-native. Mimir/Loki/Tempo as substrate. SLO authoring in OpenSLO format under microservices/<ms>/slos/.
observability.audit_chain_observability_separation: audit-chain emits to Merkle-sealed chain, not to logs substrate

data_substrate.doctrine_summary: Ontology is the canonical cross-microservice data substrate. Object Types are first-class with Cedar-gated reads. Data classes determine residency + encryption + retention.

default_policy.summary: Citus, OpenSearch, Milvus, ClickHouse, and Iceberg are workload-specific selections, not universal defaults for every microservice or cell.

non_claims: This matrix records substrate choices and manifest binding names only; it does not claim a deployed data platform, live adapters, migrations, backups, or SLO evidence.
Workload-specific substrates remain opt-in; no row makes Milvus, ClickHouse, TimescaleDB, Flink, CQRS, or object buckets universal defaults for every service.

rows.owns_access_pattern: Postgres connection pooling and tenant/shard-aware routing for services with Postgres dependencies.
rows.default_posture: required for Postgres-dependent services; transaction pool mode unless a service declares a session-mode rationale
rows.forbidden_drift: direct unpooled Postgres connections as a production default; provider-specific managed poolers as the canonical pooler

rows.substrate_choice: Postgres primary plus per-bounded-context read replicas
rows.owns_access_pattern: High-read query-side traffic for explicitly approved bounded contexts only.
rows.default_posture: disabled; opt-in only for approved high-read bounded contexts such as social.feed, messenger.search, and ontology.entity-query
rows.reconciliation_note: ADR-0172 cites pgpool-II/RDS Proxy as reference shapes; ADR-0179 selects pgcat as the platform routing/pooling substrate when this matrix is applied.

rows.substrate_choice: SeaweedFS 4.22 primary with Ceph RGW scale-up path
rows.owns_access_pattern: S3-compatible blob, artifact, evidence, warehouse cold tier, Milvus object backend, and backup target storage.
rows.default_posture: bucket preallocation via infrastructure, not runtime application bucket creation
rows.forbidden_drift: MinIO/managed-S3-only default, plaintext object credentials, or bucket names outside the platform-<purpose>-<tenant-or-shared>-<env> convention

rows.substrate_choice: Velero plus pgBackRest plus Restic on SeaweedFS, age-encrypted before write
rows.owns_access_pattern: Kubernetes state, Postgres PITR, and non-Kubernetes filesystem backup respectively.
rows.default_posture: three prongs; one concern per prong; restore-drill evidence required before runtime readiness claims
rows.forbidden_drift: Velero-only Postgres backup, pg_dump cron as PITR, native-cloud snapshot-only, or unencrypted backup payloads

rows.substrate_choice: Milvus 2.6.x disaggregated cluster; pgvector allowed only below the ADR ceiling
rows.owns_access_pattern: High-scale vector retrieval, RAG, embedding similarity, and agent memory ANN search.
rows.default_posture: disabled unless a service declares vector collections and dimensions; collection/index choice is workload-specific
rows.forbidden_drift: Pinecone/managed vector DB as canonical, pgvector above the per-tenant ceiling, or raw Milvus client calls outside the shared vector-store port

rows.substrate_choice: ClickHouse 26.3 LTS with ClickHouse Keeper for production cells
rows.owns_access_pattern: Tenant-facing dashboards, ops rollups, audit-log query, billing rollups, and wide aggregate OLAP serving.
rows.default_posture: disabled unless a service publishes or queries OLAP datasets; single-binary is dev/preview only
rows.forbidden_drift: Postgres OLTP wide-aggregate serving, per-service OLAP engine drift, or managed SaaS warehouse as canonical

rows.substrate_choice: TimescaleDB 2.26 Community Edition as a Postgres 18 extension
rows.owns_access_pattern: Tenant-facing sparse time-series with row updates and transactional consistency with adjacent OLTP rows.
rows.default_posture: disabled unless a service declares hypertables; Apache-2.0 community surface only
rows.forbidden_drift: TSL-only TimescaleDB functions, ClickHouse-only for row-update/transactional time-series, or unmanaged native partition reinvention

rows.substrate_choice: ClickHouse Materialized Views plus Kafka Engine by default; Apache Flink 2.2.x only by ADR-amended escalation
rows.owns_access_pattern: Rolling aggregates, percentile/top-K/anomaly materialization, and Flink-class stateful stream workloads when explicitly justified.
rows.default_posture: clickhouse_mv for Class-A workloads; flink requires workload proof, ADR amendment, capacity model, and runbook
rows.forbidden_drift: Flink as a universal default, Kafka Streams/ksqlDB as canonical, or per-service stream-processing engine choice without ADR amendment

data_substrate.search_substrate: workload-selected search substrate; OpenSearch only when search or log-index workloads require it
data_substrate.vector_store: workload-selected vector substrate; Milvus only when high-scale vector or RAG workloads require it

data_substrate.queue_substrate: Apache Pulsar (launch primary) with Apache Kafka, Redpanda, and RabbitMQ as first-class adapters

messaging_adapter_policy.non_claim: This records substrate direction; broker deployments, client adapters, compatibility tests, and production evidence require future ChangeSets.

data_substrate.tenant_scoped_data_isolation: workload-specific isolation plan selected per service; Citus tenant_id sharding applies only when Citus is selected, and per-tenant encryption keys flow through cloud-secrets BYOK

naming_conventions.doctrine_summary: BNF v4.1 naming (ADR-0056). Crate names follow oya-<microservice>-<bounded-context>-<layer> pattern. Microservices flat under microservices/<ms>/ per ADR-0131.

agentic_pipeline.doctrine_summary: The Foundry pipeline is the canonical agentic development pipeline. Layer-0 isolated worktree per agent; PR against dev enters the pipeline; merge queue admits via ADR-0111 projected merge state.
agentic_pipeline.admission_gate: validate policy + evidence + required status checks

resource_model.doctrine_summary: Oya cloud resources are addressed through a first-class hyperscaler-style hierarchy and ORN, not through IaC paths or Kubernetes object names alone.

resource_identity.name: Oya Resource Name
resource_identity.uniqueness_scope: global within Oya Cloud resource registry

invariants: No cloud resource is valid without account, project, region, cell, owner, lifecycle_state, quota_cost, billing_meters, audit_events, SLO tier, and deletion/retention policy metadata.
Region and cell placement are explicit control-plane fields, not inferred from provider/IaC directory layout.
FD-001 microservices hosted on Oyatie Cloud are tenant workloads under the same hierarchy; internal workloads receive no carve-out.
Stable cloud resources expose lifecycle, identity, policy, quota, billing, audit, observability, rollback, and reconciliation facets through the Cloud Control Plane.

cloud_control_plane.doctrine_summary: The user-facing Cloud Control Plane owns resource intent, identity, operations, quota, metering, and reconciliation; OpenTofu, operators, and Argo are behind-the-plane implementation mechanisms.

api_gateway.role: Authenticate, authorize, validate idempotency, normalize API requests, and emit accepted/rejected audit events before resource mutations.

resource_registry.role: Persist canonical resource identity, hierarchy placement, lifecycle_state, owner, quota/metering/billing metadata, and deletion/retention policy.

operation_ledger.role: Persist durable long-running operation state for create/update/delete and expose operation status independently of backend reconciler execution.

workflow_reconciler.role: Convert accepted resource intent into reconciler work while preserving operation ledger state and audit trail.

execution_adapters.role: Apply intent through OpenTofu, Kubernetes operators, Argo CD, or other provider adapters without becoming the public control-plane API.

required_semantics: contract-first REST/gRPC/async API projections from the shared Rust-native contract source (ZERO GraphQL per ADR-0565)
resource registry write before backend execution claim
metering/billing event emission points for lifecycle and usage
audit event emission for accepted, rejected, started, reconciled, failed, deleted, retained, and tombstoned transitions
stable resource contracts expose lifecycle, identity, policy, quota, billing, audit, observability, rollback, and reconciliation facets
cloud_control_plane.non_claim: This records the target control-plane architecture only; runtime API, registry, ledger, reconciler, provider adapter, and production evidence require later ChangeSets.

field_semantics.quota_cost: Cost units reserved or consumed from reliability quota before or during resource lifecycle transitions.
field_semantics.billing_meters: Meter ids and dimensions that define billable usage and allocation events.
field_semantics.audit_events: Event classes emitted for lifecycle, policy, quota, metering, ownership, and retention transitions.
field_semantics.lifecycle_state: Control-plane resource state machine value visible to clients and operation ledger.
field_semantics.owner: Human/service principal accountable for the resource.
field_semantics.tenant/account/project: Tenant and commercial/project scope for isolation, policy, cost, and audit rollup.
field_semantics.region/cell: Placement scope for residency, blast-radius, routing, quota pools, and cost attribution.
field_semantics.SLO tier: Reliability class that drives rollout, quota, support, alerting, and incident response.
field_semantics.deletion/retention policy: Deletion, tombstone, retention, legal hold, and recovery semantics.

invariants: Quota is reliability infrastructure and cannot be postponed to billing integration.
Billing/metering events are part of the resource contract from day one, not a later garnish.

Every new resource type must define its quota_cost, billing_meters, audit_events, lifecycle_state, owner, tenant/account/project, region/cell, SLO tier, and deletion/retention policy before implementation.

developer_platform_core.doctrine_summary: The developer platform is a core provisioning surface for Oya Cloud, not a documentation-only service catalog.
required_surface_semantics: Each provisioned artifact creates or updates Resource Registry entries where applicable.
Each provisioned artifact emits Operation Ledger state for mutating operations.
Each provisioned artifact binds quota, metering, owner, region/cell, SLO, runbook, and retention metadata before activation.
Preview environments are tenant-scoped resources under the canonical hierarchy rather than informal deploys.
developer_platform_core.non_claim: This records the developer-platform promotion requirement only; no console workflow, service catalog backend, or provisioning runtime is implemented here.

cluster_api.purpose: Declarative multi-cluster provisioning, upgrades, and fleet lifecycle for Kubernetes cells.

gateway_api.purpose: Standard Kubernetes networking API for north-south/gateway routing semantics.

openfeature.purpose: Explicit cloud rollout and release semantics for feature flags and progressive exposure.

progressive_delivery.allowed_alternative: Oya-native equivalent with explicit canary, analysis, rollback, audit, and SLO/error-budget semantics

kubernetes_fleet_and_rollout_standards.non_claim: This records standards only; no Cluster API, Gateway API, OpenFeature, FOCUS/OpenCost, Argo Rollouts, or Oya-native rollout runtime is implemented by this ChangeSet.

stable_cloud_resource_contract.doctrine_summary: Oya exposes stable cloud resources with lifecycle, identity, policy, quota, billing, audit, observability, rollback, and reconciliation as first-class control-plane facets.

facet_semantics.lifecycle: Explicit create/update/delete/suspend/resume/drain/retire/tombstone state machine visible through the control plane and operation ledger.
facet_semantics.identity: Stable ORN plus owner, tenant/account/project, region/cell, resource group, service, resource type, resource id, workload identity, and actor identity references.
facet_semantics.policy: Cedar/admission/policy decisions, data-class/residency controls, and authorization outcomes attached to resource operations and transitions.
facet_semantics.quota: Reliability quota checks, reservations, usage deltas, limits, and backpressure semantics attached to resource operations.
facet_semantics.billing: Meter definitions, billable dimensions, FOCUS-shaped export mapping, and authoritative Oya billing event handoff points.
facet_semantics.audit: Immutable audit event classes for accepted, rejected, started, reconciled, failed, rolled back, deleted, retained, and tombstoned transitions.
facet_semantics.observability: Golden signals, traces, metrics, logs, SLO tier, resource health, operation progress, and cost/usage visibility.
facet_semantics.rollback: Supported rollback/undo/compensation semantics, rollback eligibility, rollback evidence, and failure-domain constraints.
facet_semantics.reconciliation: Desired-vs-observed state, reconciler ownership, backend adapter state, retry/backoff, drift detection, and terminal/nonterminal failure semantics.

stable_cloud_resource_contract.resource_launch_ready_rule: A resource type is not considered stable or launch-ready unless all required facets are declared, validated, and exposed through the Cloud Control Plane contract.
stable_cloud_resource_contract.non_claim: This records the stable resource contract only; no resource API, controller, quota, billing, audit, observability, rollback, or reconciliation runtime is implemented by this ChangeSet.

constitutional_invariants: audience is a call tag not a microservice scope
compliance packs as first-class versioned signed bundles
reserved microservices cannot deploy; promote via ADR
self-modification through oyatie.foundry.* principals under Cedar gates
